text: Good evening. I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he's 9 months. He's had a runny, stuffy nose and he's been sneezing a lot since yesterday. He's also got a nappy rash, very red and it looks sore, he cries a bit when I change him. There's been no fits or shaking or jerking of any kind. I've not taken his temperature. Just wanted some advice on the rash mainly, and whether there's anything for the nose at his age.
